evidence.reason: Two claims survive from this gap's original evidence; four were removed as stale on 2026-08-12 after being tested individually against the repository. SURVIVING CLAIM 1: enforcement-matrix rows C1, C2, C4, C5 and C8 remain governance status proposed-v9 with representability none; the admitted ontology records that their subject matter cannot yet be represented. SURVIVING CLAIM 2, restated to current wording: C3, C6, C7, C9, C10 and C11 claim manual enforcement, and enforcement evidence is none for every one of the six. C3 and C10 are proposed-v9; C6, C7, C9 and C11 inherit normative force from v4. The absence of named attesting artifacts means the claimed manual checks are not presently evidenced for named targets. The original wording of this claim called the six adopted-manual with attestations and disclosure statements as evidence; adopted-manual no longer exists as a status in v9.1, and the evidence cells were replaced with none under correction A2, so the original wording preserved terminology the admitted ontology deliberately removed and understated the deficit. REMOVED AS STALE: that AI_LAB_CLAUDE_MAX_TOKENS defaults to 4096, when it is 16000; that no identity, endpoint, catalog, invocation or manifest object exists anywhere in ai_lab/, when eight such modules exist and 210 invocation records are retained; that COMP-0032's truncation could not be explained from an artifact's own contents, which holds for that artifact but not for records captured after 2026-08-10, 28 of which carry stop_reason; and that no mechanism exists to verify, date or supersede catalog claims, when catalog_capture.py and catalog_resolution.py exist and 140 catalog records are retained. ADDED: no record in the repository carries a role assignment, and InvocationAuthorization appears as prose in eleven files and as a record form in none. NUMERIC REFRESH at d2539d2872cf7902b89a562635ccbf5ad066903f (2026-08-21), record-only, no restructuring: 214 InvocationRecords (the reason above says 210; superseded), 38 VERIFY records carrying recorded_by (the recommended-slice text says 35; superseded), 32 records carry stop_reason via the outcome block (the removed-as-stale text says 28; superseded), and the admitted matrix has 14 constraint rows C1 to C14, of which this gap's surviving claims discuss the original 11; C12 to C14 were admitted with v9.2 and carry enforcement evidence none like the rest. The eleven-files count for InvocationAuthorization prose is not reproducible by a stated method and is restated: it appears in the admitted ontology and its proposal and review documents (4 files under ai_lab, scripts and docs/abstractions by grep) and in no Python module as a record form, which is the load-bearing claim. Both surviving claims hold unchanged: no role-assignment record exists, and enforcement evidence is none for every manual-mode constraint.

name: Invocation authorization has no record form, and six ABS-0004 constraints claim manual enforcement with no attesting artifact
notes: Expressed against admitted ABS-0004 v4 per the agreed sequence (ontology first, challenge round, then the gap). Candidate remediation path is Slices A-D of ABS-0004 Section 10, each a separately governed plan; this gap does not pre-admit any of them.

The deferred provider comparison (third-provider decision per the C5 witness-path framing, per-provider escalation ladders, live catalog verification) is intentionally sequenced after Slice B, because its subject matter is catalog assertions and identities that only Slice B makes representable.
The parked CLAUDE_MAX_TOKENS default change should ride with Slice A as a governed settings change, so the new ExecutionProfile capture records the corrected limit from its first use.

Reconciled 2026-08-12 at commit d10fd20. All seven claims in the previous summary were tested and all seven were stale: Slices A and B shipped between this gap being opened on 2026-07-20 and the reconciliation. The gap did not close because two evidence claims survived and because the enforcement deficit it describes has become the whole of what it is about.

The reconciliation was produced by the packaging executor and reviewed by the reviewing executor, which corrected the claim-6 disposition: the packaging executor had marked it holds, and the reviewing executor established that its literal wording is stale while the surviving finding is stronger. The wording above is the reviewing executor's.
recommended_first_slice: Not Slice A, which is implemented and warranted, and not Slice B, which is implemented. The readiness assessment of 2026-08-12 examined all six manual-mode constraints against what the repository already records and identified C7 as the cheapest to turn into an evidenced check: it is the only one of the six whose subject is which party did what, and all 35 VERIFY records already carry recorded_by.peer_id and repo_commit. The missing half is the implementer identity for the change being verified; git author is the operator on every commit and does not name the drafting executor. The minimum honest artifact is a verifier and implementer pair on a VERIFY record, both naming declared executor identities, with the refusal condition stated for when they match. C11 is second. C3 and C10 share a single blocker, evidence-ancestry capture, which is the largest unlock among the six and a build rather than a field.
risk: Without invocation provenance, every governed decision that relies on provider outputs rests on undisclosed execution conditions: truncations, configuration differences, session contamination, and model substitutions are invisible after the fact, as COMP-0032's truncation incident showed. Without catalog verification, unverifiable provider claims (ADVISOR-0000 class) can only be excluded by operator vigilance. Without structural authority separation, the C3/C6/C7 disciplines depend entirely on session practice and degrade silently if practice slips. Deferring representation while building routing or escalation would recreate the retrofit debt GAP-0004 was opened to prevent.
summary: ABS-0004 v9.1 defines the objects, relations and constraints under which AI-Lab authorizes invocations for roles. Slices A and B are implemented: 214 InvocationRecords carry executor reference, ExecutionProfile and EffectiveInputManifest, and 132 ModelIdentity records with 2 CatalogSnapshots back the catalog claims that were previously unverifiable by construction. What remains unrepresented is the authorization half. No role-assignment record exists, and InvocationAuthorization appears as prose in the admitted ontology and its proposal and review documents and in no Python module or record form, so the authority separation practised in sessions remains testimonial rather than structural. Separately and more consequentially, the enforcement matrix of the admitted ontology records enforcement evidence none for every one of its eleven constraints, and six of them claim manual enforcement while naming no attesting artifact.
